Hum Mutat 2018;39(11):1525-1530. PMID 30311383, doi:10.1002/humu.23642; the exception table (Table 1 in the PMC copy, PMC6188666), accessed 2026-10-19

# source: ClinGen SVI "BA1 Exception List", https://clinicalgenome.org/docs/ba1-exception-list/ (dated 2018-07-30, the list ClinGen still publishes), accessed 2026-10-19; it lists the same nine variants as the paper

# vid: each variant's record in ClinVar's GRCh38 VCF of 2026-10-11 (https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/vcf_GRCh38/clinvar.vcf.gz), found by the ClinVar variation ID the table gives; every REF checked against GRCh38 (NCBI nuccore)
# normalised: bcftools norm -m -both leaves each record as it is (biallelic); the eight SNVs cannot move, and ACAD9's insertion of TAAG after C cannot shift left (C is not G)
# hgvs: as the table writes it; ClinVar's current names use newer transcripts (BTD D444H is NM_001370658.1:c.1270G>C p.Asp424His there)
